{{dablink|For other uses of the word "sword," see [[Sword]]. For the location separating the [[Great Blight]] from the [[Westlands]], see [[Blightborder]].}}
'''Sword of the Blightborder''' is a [[title]] of the [[Saldaea]]n monarch. The title alludes to the fact that the nation is on the [[Blightborder]] and stands ready to defend the [[Westlands]] from [[Trolloc]] invasion. Currently, [[Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi]] holds this title.
